About Us
The Ministry is responsible for co-ordination of all Skill Development efforts across the country, removal of disconnect between
demand and supply of skilled manpower, building the vocational and technical training framework, skill up-gradation, building of
new skills and innovative thinking not only for existing jobs but also jobs that are to be created. The Ministry aims to skill on a
large scale with speed and high standards in order to achieve it’s vision of a ‘Skilled India’.


“Skill development of the new generation is a national need and is
the foundation of Aatmnirbhar Bharat.
